POST /accounts/{account_id}/dns_settings.description: Creates an immutable Custom Nameserver Set. To change a set, create a new one, move any zone assignments, and delete the old set.

advanced.description: Whether to allocate the nameservers from distinct Advanced anycast groups.

nameservers.description: Lists each nameserver and the number of addresses to allocate to it. Requires a unique name for each entry in the set.

ip_count.description: Number of IPv4 addresses and number of IPv6 addresses to allocate to this nameserver. All nameservers in an Advanced nameserver set must use the same value.

name.description: A unique lowercase Punycode nameserver name within the set.
